mainEntity.name: Does Stellar Property Management serve Deerfield?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Stellar Property Management provides condominium, HOA, and townhome association management in Deerfield, Illinois (ZIP 60015), backed by a Chicago office that has served area communities since 2007 — 29 associations and approximately 1,422 residences under management, with a 96% client retention rate since 2007.

mainEntity.name: What types of community associations does Stellar manage in Deerfield?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stellar's association-management model is designed for townhomes, HOAs, condominiums in Deerfield. Every client community receives a dedicated property manager, transparent monthly financial reporting, 24/7 live emergency response, and board support informed by applicable Illinois association requirements.

mainEntity.name: How much does association management cost in Deerfield?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stellar management starts at $20 per unit per month. We quote a customized flat monthly fee based on your Deerfield association's size, amenities, staffing, financial complexity, and service scope — never a percentage of your budget. We do not add a separate capital-project planning or management-oversight fee. Third-party professional and contractor costs remain association expenses.

mainEntity.name: How do we switch our Deerfield association to Stellar?

acceptedAnswer.text: Switching is a managed 30–60 day transition: once your board signs, we retrieve records from the outgoing firm, migrate banking and vendor relationships, notify owners, and open your board and resident portals. Call 773.728.0652 or request a proposal online to start.

mainEntity.name: How should a Deerfield board choose a condo or HOA management company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Compare at least three firms on the same terms: an active Illinois management firm license, a credentialed manager (CMCA, AMS or PCAM), a flat monthly fee in writing, who answers emergencies at night, and how records move during the transition. Stellar Property Management is a licensed Chicago firm (license #291000211) that has managed associations since 2007, publishes its pricing, and answers emergencies with a live person 24/7. Boards in Deerfield can score any proposals side by side with Stellar's free comparison tool at stellarpropertygroup.com/tools/compare-management-proposals.

blocks.html: Evanston
blocks.cls: font-display text-2xl text-ink mb-4 group-hover:text-gold-600 transition-colors duration-300

blocks.html: Evanston is the North Shore's most vibrant lakefront city, home to Northwestern University, a thriving downtown, and an exceptional mix of vintage lakefront condominiums, mid-century courtyard buildings, and modern transit-oriented developments. Property management in Evanston requires fluency with the city's own landlord-tenant and building regulations layered on top of Illinois condominium law. We serve Evanston associations with the responsive, detail-driven management its engaged, well-informed boards expect.

blocks.html: Skokie
blocks.cls: font-display text-2xl text-ink mb-4 group-hover:text-gold-600 transition-colors duration-300

blocks.html: Skokie is one of Chicagoland's most diverse and well-run suburbs, with a strong stock of condominium buildings, townhome communities, and homeowner associations near the Yellow Line and Old Orchard corridor. Boards in Skokie value fiscal discipline and clear communication, and our management approach delivers both — transparent budgets, dependable maintenance, and multilingual resident support where communities need it.
blocks.cls: text-sm text-slate-600 font-light leading-relaxed line-clamp-2 mb-7

blocks.html: Lincolnwood
blocks.cls: font-display text-2xl text-ink mb-4 group-hover:text-gold-600 transition-colors duration-300

blocks.html: Lincolnwood is a compact Cook County village between Chicago's far North Side and Skokie, a short drive from our Lincoln Square office. Its condominium buildings and townhome communities sit close to Touhy Avenue and the Lincolnwood Town Center area, and their boards need the same things city boards do: accurate books, dependable vendors, and a manager who answers. We bring Chicago-office responsiveness to Lincolnwood associations without a downtown-firm overhead.
